dedupe_keys.name: poland s national critical infrastructure protection programme npoik and standards annex

description: This dataset publishes the consolidated text of Poland's National Critical Infrastructure Protection Programme (Narodowy Program Ochrony Infrastruktury Krytycznej), adopted by Council of Ministers resolution 210/2015 of 2 November 2015 as amended by resolution 61/2016 of 1 June 2016, together with an annex of standards, good practices and recommendations for keeping critical infrastructure functioning. The 48-page programme sets national priorities, objectives and requirements, assigns ministers to eleven critical infrastructure systems (energy and fuels, communications, ICT networks, finance, food, water, health, transport, rescue, continuity of public administration, and chemical and radioactive substances including pipelines), and defines a three-stage identification method in which a candidate asset must meet at least two cross-cutting criteria: casualties, financial effects, need for evacuation, loss of service, recovery time, international effect and uniqueness. It describes the roles of the RCB, operators and authorities and an action plan. It was published by the RCB on the Polish open data portal in March 2017 as two downloadable XML documents; no licence is stated in the portal's resource metadata. Caveats: the text is in Polish, it describes criteria, not listing designated assets, and later updates are not included. It informs interdependency and cascading failure scoping and resilience governance; a related record is the US National Infrastructure Protection Plan.
